justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/jsoup/safety/Safelist.java` and searched `src/main/java` and `src/test/java` for `Protocol` references. `Protocol` is a package-private nested value type used only inside `Safelist` (field type plus `addProtocols`, `removeProtocols`, `testValidProtocol`, copy logic, and its factory), with no other classes depending on it and only one outgoing dependency via `TypedValue`. That is not hub-like modularization.
